duplicate_fraction.definition: 1 - unique rounded generated images / generated images
duplicate_fraction.limitations: zero duplicates does not imply privacy
duplicate_fraction.normalization: generated images rounded to 8-bit pixel values
duplicate_fraction.sample_count_sensitivity: more reliable with larger generated batches

feature_mmd.definition: RBF-kernel MMD on handcrafted image summaries: channel means/stds, gradient summaries, local patch std, and quadrant means
feature_mmd.limitations: handcrafted features are not a validated pathology quality metric
feature_mmd.normalization: features are standardized using validation-feature mean/std
feature_mmd.sample_count_sensitivity: high for small batches; use repeated generation seeds

gradient_mean_abs_error.definition: absolute error in mean finite-difference gradient magnitude
gradient_mean_abs_error.limitations: detects edge amount, not medically meaningful structure
gradient_mean_abs_error.sample_count_sensitivity: moderate; stabilizes with more images and pixels

gradient_std_abs_error.definition: absolute error in std of finite-difference gradient magnitude
gradient_std_abs_error.sample_count_sensitivity: moderate; noisy for tiny image samples

local_patch_std_abs_error.definition: absolute error in average 4x4 patch-level pixel standard deviation
local_patch_std_abs_error.limitations: penalizes overly smooth images but does not identify realistic tissue morphology
local_patch_std_abs_error.sample_count_sensitivity: sensitive to image size and local texture diversity

pairwise_distance_mean_abs_error.definition: absolute error in mean pairwise Euclidean distance between images
pairwise_distance_mean_abs_error.limitations: measures diversity scale, not sample usefulness
pairwise_distance_mean_abs_error.normalization: distances are divided by sqrt(number of pixels)

pixel_mean_abs_error.limitations: can favor bland images if used alone
pixel_mean_abs_error.sample_count_sensitivity: global means stabilize quickly but can hide poor local structure

pixel_std_abs_error.limitations: global variance does not prove realistic spatial organization
pixel_std_abs_error.sample_count_sensitivity: sensitive to small sample batches and class mix

selection_score.definition: 1 / (1 + weighted error sum) using validation-only metrics
selection_score.direction: higher is better for relative ranking
selection_score.limitations: heuristic ranking score; no threshold establishes clinical or release quality
selection_score.normalization: bounded in (0, 1], but not calibrated as probability or quality acceptance
selection_score.sample_count_sensitivity: depends on generated sample count and random seed
